about: The falsifier: a capsule's reads met against a place's leaves instead of against what the place offers. Every reader then reaches every leaf its globs fit anywhere in the tree: the runtime reader, which reads obligations/src, would read every TypeScript source of every place.

cases.name: runtime, reads *.ts, met against source leaves
cases.leaves: 63 by its line, 360 by its globs

cases.name: vocabulary, reads *.ts|*.json, met against source leaves
cases.leaves: 296 by its line, 779 by its globs

cases.name: hazards, reads src/**@2, met against source leaves
cases.reach: 7 places by its line, 332 leaves by its globs
